# HydroLoop Farm

> HydroLoop Farm is a Moroccan, patent-pending modular vertical hydroponic system. A self-supporting A-Frame (2.0 × 2.0 × 1.5 m, 4 m² footprint) carries three levels of NFT channels, each with its own independent closed nutrient loop. Plants move up one level every 20–27 days, so a 48-plant module harvests continuously with no idle period. A companion app, the HydroLoop Farm Manager (developed by AIWorkPay), tracks every batch from seed to harvest.

Key facts:

- Designer and patent holder: Ahmed Akafou. Patent application filed with OMPIC (Morocco); PCT extension planned; IPC A01G31/02.
- App developer: AIWorkPay.
- Contact: contact@aiworkpay.fr · +33 6 02 40 51 47 (phone and WhatsApp).
- Module: 3 levels (200 / 300 / 400 mm channels), 16 plants per level, 48 per module; reservoirs 100 / 50 / 50 L; EC 1.2–1.6 / 1.8–2.2 / 2.4–2.8 mS/cm; 2% channel slope.
- Rotation: germination days 0–9 off-module, level 1 from day 10, then one level up every 20–27 days; 13.5–18.25 harvests per year.
- Water: more than 80% less than soil-based growing (closed loop, no drainage).
- Versions: HydroLoop Farm (heated greenhouse, sunlight + automatic LED top-up, 24–28 °C) and HydroLoop Inside (opaque room or container, per-level full-spectrum LED, sensors).
- Traceability: Taqnin ID Batch identifier per cohort; GACP, pre-GMP ready, ANRAC (Law 13-21), ONSSA.
- Target region: cooperatives in the Rif (Al Hoceima, Chefchaouen, Taounate, Tétouan), Morocco.
- Not stated on this site: prices, yields per plant and a public app URL. Ask by email for these.
